sources.title: 上海大学国际预科项目2027年春季招生简章
sources.publisher: Shanghai University, College of International Education

languageRequirements.minimum: 原则上HSK3及180分以上或同等水平；未达标但有预科学习需求者根据学生情况另行安排。

faculty.en: College of International Education, Shanghai University
faculty.zh: 上海大学国际教育学院

overview.en: Non-degree preparation for undergraduate study for international students, with engineering/science and humanities/economics/management directions combining intensive Chinese, academic Chinese and foundation subject study.
overview.zh: 面向国际学生的本科学前预备教育非学历项目，提供理工与人文经管两个方向的汉语强化、专业中文与基础学科训练。

qualification.zh: 本科学前预备教育非学历项目

languagePolicy.en: Primarily taught in Chinese; the curriculum may be adjusted for progression requirements and students’ academic ability.
languagePolicy.zh: 主要为中文授课；培养方案可能根据升学要求及学生学术能力调整。

curriculumHighlights.en: Intensive Chinese, academic Chinese, foundation mathematics, Experiencing China and an academic salon.
curriculumHighlights.zh: 汉语强化基础课、专业中文、预科数学、体验中国与上大学术沙龙。

curriculumHighlights.en: Engineering/science direction offers physics/chemistry electives; humanities/economics/management offers economics/management foundations, with CSCA and HSK preparation.
curriculumHighlights.zh: 理工方向含物理/化学选课；人文经管方向含经济学/管理学基础选课，并有CSCA与HSK专项辅导。

eligibility.en: High school graduation or equivalent. Current graduates may initially provide an expected-graduation certificate but must submit the final diploma before enrollment.
eligibility.zh: 高中毕业或具有同等学历；应届生可先提供预毕业证明，但入学前必须补齐正式毕业证。

eligibility.en: Non-Chinese citizen holding a valid foreign passport and meeting the Ministry of Education rules on international students.
eligibility.zh: 持外国有效护照的非中国籍公民，并符合教育部国际学生相关规定。

eligibility.en: Good physical and mental health, no criminal record, and compliance with the medical examination standards for study in China.
eligibility.zh: 须身心健康，无违法犯罪记录，满足来华留学体检标准。
入学年龄16周岁（含）至24周岁（含）。

eligibility.en: In principle, HSK 3 with at least 180 points or equivalent Chinese proficiency. Applicants below that level who need foundation study receive separate arrangements based on their circumstances; no automatic waiver is promised.
eligibility.zh: 原则上汉语达到HSK3及180分以上或同等水平；未达标但有预科学习需求者根据学生情况另行安排。

applicationMaterials.en: Ordinary passport information page, valid for more than one year. Passport details cannot change from admission until registration is completed.
applicationMaterials.zh: 有效普通护照信息页（有效期超过一年）；录取后至报到完成前护照信息不可变更。

applicationMaterials.en: Applicants already in China must provide their valid visa information page.
applicationMaterials.zh: 在华学生须提供有效签证信息页。

applicationMaterials.en: Color, bareheaded ID photo taken within six months, at least 295×413 pixels and at most 200 KB.
applicationMaterials.zh: 近六个月内彩色免冠证件照，像素≥295×413、文件≤200KB。

applicationMaterials.en: Signed study plan of 300–500 Chinese characters covering personal background, interests and strengths, intended major, and reasons for applying.
applicationMaterials.zh: 本人签字的300—500字学习计划，含个人背景、爱好特长、意向专业、申请原因等。

applicationMaterials.en: High school diploma or equivalent; current graduates may submit an expected-graduation certificate and must obtain the diploma before enrollment.
applicationMaterials.zh: 高中毕业或同等学力证明；应届毕业生提供预毕业证明，并在入学前取得毕业证。

applicationMaterials.en: High school transcript covering all courses; current graduates provide every course result available at application time.
applicationMaterials.zh: 高中出具的高中阶段全部课程成绩单；应届生提交截至申请时已获得的全部成绩。

applicationMaterials.en: Scan or webpage screenshot of an HSK Level 3 or higher result from within the past two years.
applicationMaterials.zh: 近两年内HSK3级及以上成绩扫描件或网页截屏。

applicationMaterials.en: Applicants under 18 provide a guarantee from a guardian in China.
applicationMaterials.zh: 不满18周岁者提交在华监护人保证书。

applicationMaterials.en: Award certificates, if any, and other supporting documents. Applicants intending art majors prepare their own portfolio, such as artwork, music-level certificates, or short films.
applicationMaterials.zh: 获奖证书（如有）及其他支撑性材料；申请艺术专业者须自行准备作品（美术作品、音乐等级证明、电影短片等）。

applicationMaterials.en: Documents in other languages require notarized Chinese or English translations. Upload scans without mailing paper documents; present the originals for checking at registration.
applicationMaterials.zh: 非中文或英文材料须附经公证的中文或英文翻译件；申请时仅上传扫描件，无需邮寄，报到时提交原件备查。

notes.en: Starts in March 2027; the exact date follows the admission notice. This non-degree undergraduate foundation project has engineering/science and humanities/economics/management directions and is primarily Chinese-taught. Curriculum may change with progression requirements and academic ability; the detailed timetable follows registration. Successful completion, HSK4/5 at least 180 and a passed CSCA test permit an application to a September Shanghai University undergraduate programme, not guaranteed admission. Pay the non-refundable CNY500 application fee within two weeks of preliminary approval or the application will no longer be accepted. After the electronic admission notice, pay tuition in full; formal admission documents are emailed after payment evidence is confirmed. CNY26000 per semester includes tuition, CSCA preparation, HSK mock testing and undergraduate-application guidance. Group comprehensive insurance bought in China is required for registration and costs CNY400 per semester. Dormitory prices are CNY140/70/35 per bed per day for single/double/four-person rooms, excluding electricity and incidental fees, subject to adjustment and limited availability; arrange safe off-campus housing if unavailable. Applicants bear exchange-rate differences and transaction charges; overseas remittances use US dollars and domestic remittances use CNY, following official school instructions. Minimum cohort size is ten; otherwise the project does not open and tuition paid is refunded under the school refund rules. Merit scholarships may be applied for, with criteria to be announced and no award promised. False application information cancels application, admission or study eligibility. The school retains final interpretation of project policies.
notes.zh: 2027年3月开学，具体日期以录取通知书为准；本项目为非学历本科预备教育，含理工、人文经管两个方向，主要中文授课。培养方案可按升学要求和学术能力调整，报到后提供详细课表。顺利结业、汉语达到HSK4/5级180分及以上且通过CSCA测试者，可申请当年9月上海大学本科，并非自动录取。初审确认后两周内支付500元不退申请费，逾期不再受理；电子录取通知后支付全额学费，学校确认付款凭据后邮件发放正式录取材料。26000元/学期包含学费、CSCA备考、HSK模考、本科申请指导。须在中国购买团体综合保险，400元/一学期。住宿按元/床/天：单人间140、双人间70、四人间35，不含电费等杂费，可能调整；宿位紧张，未订到者自行在校外寻找安全住所。汇率差和手续费由本人承担；境外汇款使用美元，境内使用人民币，须按校方正式通知支付。每项目至少10人，不足则不开班，已缴学费退还，退费标准参见学校官网。奖学金可由成绩和表现优异者申请，细则另行发布，未承诺获奖。材料或信息虚假将取消申请、录取或学习资格。学校保留有关政策最终解释权。

tuitionSchedule.en: CNY26,000 per semester, including tuition, CSCA preparation, HSK mock tests and undergraduate-application guidance. The separate non-refundable application fee is CNY500 and required group comprehensive insurance costs CNY400 per semester; accommodation and other charges are additional.
tuitionSchedule.zh: 26000元/学期，包含学费、CSCA备考、HSK模考及本科申请指导；另有不退还申请费500元、每学期团体综合保险400元，住宿及其他费用另计。

evidence.derivation: The university explicitly calls the route non-degree pre-university education; foundation is the catalog category, not a bachelor degree.

evidence.quote: (二)申请资格 1. 高中毕业或具有同等学历。(应届生可先提供学校出具的预毕业证明,入学前必须补齐正式 毕业证。) 2. 持外国有效护照的非中国籍公民,并符合教育部《关于规范我高等学校接受国际学生有关工 作的通知》等相关规定。 3. 申请人须身心健康,无违法犯罪记录,满足来华留学体检标准。 4. 入学年龄需在 16 周岁(含)至 24 周岁(含)之间。 5. 原则上,申请人汉语水平需要达到 HSK3 及 180 分以上或同等水平。 *注:如语言水平未达标学生有学习预科的需求,根据学生情况另行安排。 (三)申请材料

申请人应保证所提供的申请材料及信息的真实、准确、完整,一经查证为不属实,将被取消申请、 录取或学习资格。 1. 有效普通护照信息页(有效期超过一年),一经录取,直至入学报到完成前,护照信息不可 变更。 2. 有效签证信息页(在华学生须提供) 3. 近六个月内的个人证件照片(彩色,免冠,照片像素≥295*413,大小≤200KB)。 4. 学习计划,须本人签字,内容包括但不限于个人背景、爱好特长、意向专业、申请原因等, 300-500 字。 5. 高中毕业或同等学力证明。应届毕业生须提供由学校开具的预毕业证明,并于入学前取得高 中毕业证书。 6. 高中学业水平证明: 由所在高中出具的成绩单(含高中阶段所有课程)。应届毕业生须提供 截至申请时已获得的高中阶段所有课程成绩单。 7. 近两年内汉语水平证明,HSK 3 级及以上成绩扫描件或网页截屏。 8. 经济担保证明 9. 无犯罪记录证明 10. 不满 18 周岁需提供在华监护人保证书 (模板 8.9.10 可在 apply.shu.edu.cn/application/index 下载) 2 11. 获奖证书(如有)及其他支撑性材料。 *注: 1以上所有申请材料若非中文或英文,须提供经公证后的中文或英文翻译件。 2申请阶段无需邮寄纸质申请材料。以上材料申请时仅需要上传扫描件,开学报到时需提供原件备查。
